# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 7  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Davy has a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets, paired with a distinct snub nose. When he laughs, a single dimple appears in one cheek while the other remains smooth, giving him a charming and comical lopsided look.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a heedless, forgetful, and mischievous child who often creates trouble, though he is also considered a reformed character. Marked by an inquisitive nature and a lively curiosity, he frequently asks questions and wants to see everything that is going on. He lacks imagination and takes a practical view of things, driven by the desire to eventually become a storekeeper so he can keep plenty of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P30](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0030), +4 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as a baby and lived with his sick mother, receiving little discipline during his early childhood. Following his mother's death, he and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), were taken in by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy quickly established a reputation for disruptive mischief, which included causing a scene at church by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck, forcing [Dora](../character/dora.md) to walk a pigpen fence, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, and locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) inside a toolhouse. Though prone to lying and skipping his prayers, he repeatedly confessed his misdeeds to [Anne](../character/anne.md), who corrected his confused beliefs about heaven and the catechism. After ruining lemon pies meant for a visiting author and growing jealous of Anne's pupil [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Davy learned that the death of a relative had provided a trust fund allowing him and [Dora](../character/dora.md) to stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As he settled into school life and routine at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), he continued to entertain and challenge [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with his lively antics and curious questions.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), +552 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “I’ll do it,” volunteered Davy, “if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) serves as a teacher and mentor figure helping to raise Davy after he is taken in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy's mischievous antics, such as sneaking a toad into Marilla's bed, often bring him to [Anne](../character/anne.md), who covers for him, counsels him on morality, and patiently helps guide his behavior.

- Student of — teacher helping to bring him up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a fond and forgiving guardian to Davy, helping manage his frequent misdeeds. Though Davy creates trouble, such as locking his sister in a toolhouse, [Anne](../character/anne.md) handles his tearful confessions with gentleness and helps keep him on the right path.

- Friend of — fond companion  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister who came with him to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after their mother's death. Davy frequently targets her with his rowdy behavior and pranks, such as ruining her dress, pumping water over her, and locking her inside a neighbor's toolhouse.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +5 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's relative and strict guardian who takes him and his sister into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) enforces discipline and orders when Davy gets into trouble, she genuinely cares for him and works with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to raise the mischievous boy.

- Serves under — guardian who gives orders and disciplines him  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>
- Friend of — caring for him at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- Relative of — guardian taking care of him  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>
